name: Contact
description: A contact with hostiles. Fight your way through; the spoils are standard.

name: Strongpoint
description: A strongpoint held by a tougher force. Harder to take, but the loot is better.

name: Event
description: Something unexpected on the road that calls for a decision.

name: Cache
description: A stash of supplies and gear to be picked up without a fight.

name: Rest point
description: A quiet place to recover. It costs supplies, but heals and lowers stress.

name: Unknown
description: You cannot tell what is here until you are near it or step in.

name: Objective
description: The goal of the mission, at the end of the map.

name: Commander Crisis
description: A fight in which you are exposed. One unit must cover you; if you fall, the fight is lost.
